scientific.integrity: The full-conflict DEAM branch is reduced to an exact scalar affine momentum recurrence and a forced first-order update recurrence. Closed forms and interval-certified signs establish the exact parameter and momentum reversal times.
limitations: Externally prescribed equal-magnitude permanent gradient reversal.
Scalar source-form DEAM with constant learning rate over the reversal window.
Not a convergence theorem for parameter-dependent gradients.
The broader source convergence and empirical claims are outside the finding.

title: DEAM backtracking saves exactly one stale step after a full reversal
